items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Benny Carter. I know I'm leaving some out.

ctx.x: Fattis, somebody else. There's so many -- there were 51 guys up there, you know. And a lot of saxophone players. Zoot Sims, Al Cohn, Budd Johnson, Benny Carter. I know I'm leaving some out. Phil Woods. There's some amazing guys up there. And Buddy DeFranco was up there. And Buddy Tate. And what's that guy who used to arrange for Basie? Tenor man. Ernie Wilkins.
